title: 1-click rollback for production deploys
author: hana
text: Adds a one-click rollback button to deploy-pipeline that restores the previous release in under 60s. Motivated by PLAT-102.

title: SAML assertion parsing for Okta
author: ravi
text: Parse and validate SAML assertions from Okta. Part of PLAT-130 Enterprise SSO.

title: OIDC / SAML provider config UI
author: ben
text: Settings page in web-app for workspace admins to configure their SSO provider. Part of Enterprise SSO.

title: Per-workspace SSO enforcement
author: ravi
text: When a workspace enables SSO enforcement, password login is disabled for its members. Requested by Initech. PLAT-130.

title: refund-engine: enforce 14-day window for monthly plans
author: diego
text: Implements BILL-219. Monthly plans: refunds allowed within 14 days of charge. Annual plans: prorated refunds. Effective Sept 1.

title: Usage meter aggregation
author: lena
text: Aggregate usage events from kafka-events into hourly billable meters. Part of BILL-240 / Usage-Based Pricing.

title: Dual-write ledger entries to Postgres
author: tomasz
text: Writes every ledger entry to MySQL and Postgres. Project Atlas, PLAT-141.

title: Backfill script and checksum verifier
author: tomasz
text: Backfills historical ledger entries into Postgres and verifies per-account checksums. Needed for the Atlas cutover. PLAT-149.

title: Cutover feature flag for billing-service ledger reads
author: tomasz
text: Flag to switch billing-service ledger reads from MySQL to Postgres at cutover. Project Atlas.

title: Add refund-request features to churn score
author: nina
text: Adds refund requests and support ticket volume as churn-model features. DATA-60.
